tools.name: kapruka_list_delivery_cities
tools.description:
List or search Sri Lankan cities Kapruka delivers to.

    Use the `query` param to filter (e.g. "colombo" → all Colombo zones,
    "anur" → Anuradhapura). Without a query you get the first 25 cities
    alphabetically, which is rarely what an agent needs — pass a query.

    Returns canonical city

tools.name: kapruka_gift_countries
tools.description:
List the countries Kapruka delivers gifts IN (international gift stores).

    Use when the RECIPIENT is outside Sri Lanka — e.g. "send flowers to my sister in
    Dubai", "a cake for my son in Melbourne". These gifts are delivered by Kapruka's
    partner in that country, not shipped from Sri Lanka

tools.name: kapruka_gift_country_products
tools.description:
List EVERY gift in stock in one country's store (international gifts), grouped by type.

    The stores are small (tens of products), so this returns the whole store: read it
    and choose for the customer — there is no keyword search for these products.
    Prices are exactly what checkout charges

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kapruka_list_categories, kapruka_get_product, kapruka_search_products, kapruka_create_order, kapruka_render_options_card, kapruka_check_delivery, kapruka_gift_country_products · Private data: kapruka_track_order · Public sink: kapruka_create_order, kapruka_track_order, kapruka_render_options_card, kapruka_gift_countries · Destructive: kapruka_list_categories, kapruka_get_product, kapruka_search_products, kapruka_create_order, kapruka_track_order, kapruka_list_delivery_cities, kapruka_check_delivery.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kapruka_list_categories, kapruka_get_product, kapruka_search_products, kapruka_create_order, kapruka_render_options_card, kapruka_check_delivery, kapruka_gift_country_products · Private data: kapruka_track_order · Public sink: kapruka_create_order, kapruka_track_order, kapruka_render_options_card, kapruka_gift_countries · Destructive: kapruka_list_categories, kapruka_get_product, kapruka_search_products, kapruka_create_order, kapruka_track_order, kapruka_list_delivery_cities, kapruka_check_delivery

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
